title: Drinkology
subtitle: Hyper-Casual | Party Game | Mobile | Multiplayer
content: A casual party game made for mobile devices.
summary: Designed mobile party-game systems, King's Cup logic, asset integration, and Google Play release support.
description: Drinkology is a mobile party game featuring multiple mini-games, including King's Cup with an in-app deck and quick competitive tap challenges.
roles: Designed and developed the game's core concept
Developed King's Cup game logic and collaborated with other developers to integrate it into the game
Collaborated with artists on asset creation and integration
Supported Google Play policy requirements and release preparation
details: This game started as a solo weekend project and later became a small group project. It took around one month to complete and release on Google Play during my Master's studies at RIT. My work focused on gameplay features and the design logistics needed to make a simple mobile party game feel quick, readable, and fun in a social setting. I implemented systems such as card shuffling, random draws, and King's Cup logic while also contributing to game design, asset integration, and release preparation.
